correctness.rationale: On R⊕K with R=K[t]/(t^n), direct composition of a commuting map (av+bwt^(n−1),c v(0)+dw) gives the four equations in the source. In their radical lie d and a_0, and then inductively a_s for 2s<n−1, from the degree-2s equations. The remaining ideal bc or u²+bc is radical after every field extension (the latter is primitive and linear in b over K[u,c]), proving the claimed reduced isomorphisms, not just a pointwise equality over a finite field. The odd cone has only the vertex as its geometric singular set even in characteristic two; this is a reduced-locus assertion, not a claim about the Jacobian subscheme. For nonzero a of valuation s with c=0, the image is aR; with c≠0, a(t)tR contributes n−s−1 dimensions and the image of (1,0) adds one, and any extra b-column belongs to a(t)tR in the odd branch s=(n−1)/2. Counting these valuations and the a=0 rank-one maps gives the stated polynomial and totals. An independently written direct matrix check over F2 (n=2..6), F3 and F4 (n=2..4) matched; F2 ambient enumeration at n=2,3 also verified centralizer sizes and ranks.
